verdict.rationale: EDD's e-Services for Business documents a sanctioned third-party rail. Third-party representatives (tax preparers, bookkeepers, agents, accountants) can enroll to manage a client's employer payroll tax account, and employers can authorize a power of attorney online. The evidence is short summary lines, and the transactional portal was not inspectable (robots.txt returned 403). Missing for 10: detail on the scope and permission levels of representative access, how authorization is revoked or audited, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the representative enrollment flow.
